title: CPF Module Schema: Service Bus Queue module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-servicebusqueue'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_rules.type: map(object({ listen = optional(bool) send = optional(bool) manage = optional(bool) }))
authorization_rules.description: (Optional) A map of servicebus_queue_authorization_rule object as defined below. This creates a `azurerm_servicebus_queue_authorization_rule` for each item in the map: Key = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Service Bus Queue Authorization Rule. Should be unique for each Queue." Value = object({ listen = "(Optional) Grants listen access to this this Authorization Rule. Defaults to `false`." send = "(Optional) Grants send access to this this Authorization Rule. Defaults to `false`." manage = "(Optional) Grants manage access to this this Authorization Rule. When this property is `true` - both `listen` and `send` must be too. Defaults to `false`." })

auto_delete_on_idle.description: (Optional) The ISO 8601 timespan duration of the idle interval after which the Queue is automatically deleted, minimum of 5 minutes.

batched_operations_enabled.description: (Optional) Boolean flag which controls whether server-side batched operations are enabled. Defaults to `false`.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dead_lettering_on_message_expiration.description: (Optional) Boolean flag which controls whether the Queue has dead letter support when a message expires.

default_message_ttl.description: (Optional) The ISO 8601 timespan duration of the TTL of messages sent to this queue. This is the default value used when TTL is not set on message itself.

duplicate_detection_history_time_window.description: (Optional) The ISO 8601 timespan duration during which duplicates can be detected. Defaults to 10 minutes (`PT10M`).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

express_enabled.description: (Optional) Boolean flag which controls whether Express Entities are enabled. An express queue holds a message in memory temporarily before writing it to persistent storage.

forward_dead_lettered_messages_to.description: (Optional) The name of a Queue or Topic to automatically forward Dead Letter messages to. Please see the documentation for more information.

forward_to.description: (Optional) The name of a Queue or Topic to automatically forward messages to.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

lock_duration.description: (Optional) The ISO 8601 timespan duration of a peek-lock; that is, the amount of time that the message is locked for other receivers. Maximum value is 5 minutes. Defaults to 1 minute (`PT1M`).

max_delivery_count.description: (Optional) Integer value which controls when a message is automatically dead lettered. Defaults to `10`.

max_message_size_in_kilobytes.description: (Optional) Integer value which controls the maximum size of a message allowed on the queue for Premium SKU. Value must be between `1024` and `102400`.

max_size_in_megabytes.description: (Optional) Integer value which controls the size of memory allocated for the queue. For supported values see the 'Queue or topic size' section of Service Bus Quotas. Defaults to `5120`.

name.description: (Optional) Specifies the name of the ServiceBus Queue resource. If not provided, the resource name is created leveraging LSEG variables as per standard naming convention. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

namespace_id.description: (Required) The ID of the ServiceBus Namespace to create this queue in. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

partitioning_enabled.description: (Optional) Boolean flag which controls whether to enable the queue to be partitioned across multiple message brokers. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Defaults to false for Basic and Standard.

requires_duplicate_detection.description: (Optional) Boolean flag which controls whether the Queue requires duplicate detection. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

requires_session.description: Indicates whether the Service Bus queue requires sessions.

status.description: (Optional) The status of the Queue. Possible values are `Active`, `Creating`, `Deleting`, `Disabled`, `ReceiveDisabled`, `Renaming`, `SendDisabled`, `Unknown`. Note that Restoring is not accepted. Defaults to `Active`

id.description: The ID of the Service Bus Queue created.

name.description: The Name of the Service Bus Queue created.

resource.description: The Service Bus Queue resource created.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Servicebusqueue' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
